== Summary ==
Slip of [[Lone Pilot (V)]] (Virtual Block 6.1, slip 45) as printed in the '''first copy''' of the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (“Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV”, “Official text as of September 4, 2009”; PDF made 3 September 2009, attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf on the [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum]). It shows the '''original''' text (“a system with 1”). The revised sheet's slip ([[:File:VB6-45-Lone_Pilot.png]]) shows the later PC-E1 text (“with exactly 1”, [[Lone Pilot (V) (Errata)]]).

* '''Original text:''' “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: ▲ Black Leader, Bossk, Dengar, DS-61-2, or Guri (may also ▲ a system with 1 [Dark Side Force], a matching starship, and an always [Immune to Alter] Effect.) When drawing your starting hand, draw four cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026, cropped from page 6 of that PDF rendered at 400 dpi, scaled to 757 px wide (as the other Virtual Block 6 slip files).
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
